data.one_liner: AppBar that animates its height when navigating between pages.
data.what_it_does: Provides a BaseLayout and AnimatedAppBar widget that smoothly change the AppBar height during page transitions. Includes helper methods for routing with custom AppBar widgets.
use_when: You need animated AppBar height changes during navigation
You want a simple way to animate AppBar without writing custom animation code
avoid_when: You require complex navigation logic beyond simple page pushes
You need a full‑featured navigation solution
strengths: Easy to integrate with minimal code
Handles key management for smooth animations
weaknesses: Relies on custom BaseLayout, not compatible with existing Scaffold structures
